message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places where you can order a birthday cake online:

## **Top Online Birthday Cake Ordering Options**

### **International & Nationwide Delivery**

| Website | Best For | Key Features |
|---------|----------|------------|
| **Bake Me a Wish** | Best overall for US delivery | Large selection, personalized messages, overnight shipping, kosher & gluten-free options |
| **Goldbelly** | Famous bakery cakes from across the US | Cakes from iconic bakeries (Carlo's, Ovenly, etc.), filters for dietary needs (vegan, paleo, gluten-free, kosher) |
| **IGP (Indian Gifts Portal)** | Delivery to India & 100+ countries | Same-day delivery, 400+ Indian cities, photo cakes, theme cakes, eggless options |
| **FNP (Ferns N Petals)** | India & international delivery | 2-hour delivery in 350+ Indian cities, midnight delivery, designer cakes |

### **Regional Options**

| Region | Website | Features |
|--------|---------|----------|
| **Philippines** | Flower Chimp | Ube cakes, rainbow cakes, Red Ribbon partnership, delivery across Philippines |
| **Malaysia** | FNP Malaysia | Same-day delivery in KL, Johor Bahru, Shah Alam, etc. |
| **Dubai/UAE** | Habib Bakery | Same-day & next-day delivery, custom designer cakes, Galaxy Kunafa, Kinder Bueno cakes |
| **UAE** | White Rose Flowers | 1-hour delivery in Abu Dhabi & Sharjah, 3-hour delivery across Emirates |
| **Hong Kong** | I Love Babycakes / Vission Bakery | Homestyle cakes, custom orders, vegan/dairy-free options |
| **UK** | Waitrose / The Hummingbird Bakery | Supermarket convenience (Waitrose), colorful American-style cakes (Hummingbird - London only) |

### **What to Look For When Ordering**

- **Same-day or next-day delivery** for last-minute needs
- **Customization options** (photos, messages, themes)
- **Dietary accommodations** (eggless, gluten-free, vegan, kosher)
- **Delivery area coverage** (some sites are city/region-specific)
- **Add-ons** like flowers, balloons, chocolates, or cards

### **How to Order**

1. Browse the website and select your cake type/flavor
2. Choose size and customize (message, photo, decorations)
3. Enter delivery address and select delivery date/time
4. Add any extras (flowers, balloons, etc.)
5. Complete payment and track your order

Most platforms accept major credit cards and offer customer support for special requests. For the freshest cakes with the most reliable delivery, I recommend ordering at least 24-48 hours in advance when possible, though same-day options are available from many services.

---
